name: Net User (SA)
help: Get detailed information about a specific user account.
long_help: Retrieves detailed information about a user account including: account status (enabled/disabled), delegation settings, password policy, group memberships (local and global), logon information, profile paths, and account expiration. Queries the local system by default, or a domain controller if a domain is specified.

arguments.name: domain
arguments.desc: Domain or server to query (defaults to local system if not specified)
